## Scope and result

**Scoped exact minimum of eight paid factors; no new kappa.** In the full group algebra `F2[S5]`, generated by the four adjacent transpositions `s1=(12), s2=(23), s3=(34), s4=(45)`, the target `diag([c],[c^-1])`, where `c=s1*s2*s3*s4` is a 5-cycle, has no word of length at most seven in the 24-factor alphabet

```text
D_N(si) = I + ([si] + [1]) N,
```

with all six rank-one idempotents `N` in `M2(F2)` allowed for each generator. The direct independent-coordinate construction uses eight factors, so the exact minimum in this two-register formal model is eight. Equality in the full group algebra certifies the action on arbitrary dirty inputs for these two registers.

The complete radius-seven meet-in-the-middle search builds the prefix ball through length three and suffix ball through length four. It covers 14,425 raw prefix words and 346,201 raw suffix words before deduplication; the exact balls contain 6,505 and 93,121 matrix states. It finds zero target hits. The certificate records every per-depth state count and digest. All 24 factors are checked involutive; a planted three-call target is recovered; reverse-orientation, dropped-factor, and wrong-generator controls pass.

## Reproduction

```sh
python3 -I -B research/s5-inverse-fivecycle-seed52bf211c/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/s5-inverse-fivecycle-seed52bf211c --check-only
```

Both commands passed locally under CPython 3.14.7. The package metadata and source-pin check passed. The registered package runner requests Python 3.12, which is unavailable locally.
